source.title: Data centres need power, but lower-income, rural residents pay the price
source.scope: Reviewed the original peer-reviewed paper record and Cornell methods summary, including projected facilities, grid investment, household geography, allocation assumptions and limitations.
source.freshness_reason: Selected as a justified 168-hour scientific-paper fallback because its methods and distributional evidence add value unavailable from newer release announcements.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the original peer-reviewed paper record and Cornell methods summary, including projected facilities, grid investment, household geography, allocation assumptions and limitations.

complete_compiler_story.summary: A Nature Energy study led by Cornell researchers models where U.S. data-center electricity costs and infrastructure burdens may fall. The analysis links projected facilities, grid investment and household geography, finding that lower-income and rural residents can face disproportionate costs. Results depend on buildout, utility and allocation assumptions; they are not a measured bill forecast for every community.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Before approving AI capacity, add household bill exposure and local grid investment to the site review. Test multiple buildout and cost-allocation assumptions, publish who bears each scenario, and treat modeled distributional effects as planning evidence rather than certain future charges.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Peer-reviewed paper record and Cornell methods summary reviewed; model assumptions and geographic limits remain explicit.

complete_compiler_story.summary: United says it is restricting unauthorized third-party personal AI agents across its digital platforms, travel agencies and aggregators. The airline cites shared credentials, sensitive information, unintended purchases or account changes, loyalty-point use and required human acknowledgments during check-in. The notice states a policy direction; it does not document measured incident rates or a universal industry rule.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Map every assistant that can reach a customer account, then separate reading, recommendation and transaction permissions.
